shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: No skill shot as such — instead a menu of launch awards to pick from before the ball reaches the flippers.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Carries a kickback that goes dark after a save and needs the three standups above it cleared to come back.

shots.name: Kickback Standups
shots.notes: Three red standups above the left outlane; clearing all three relights the kickback.

shots.name: Left Loop
shots.notes: More often than not this doesn't complete a full loop — it falls into one of the sink holes at the top of the game instead.

shots.name: Mystery Target
shots.notes: Sits next to the left loop.

shots.name: Left Ramp
shots.notes: Advances the left security level toward Payback Time and feeds the left inlane.

shots.name: TX Lock Lane
shots.notes: A game-controlled drop target sits halfway along with a sink hole at the end. Real ball locks — a fresh ball launches after each one. Roughly 40% of shots here drained between the flippers on the reviewed unit, so aim it with intent.

shots.name: TX Shooter Eject
shots.notes: A small ejector just right of the lock lane.

shots.name: Red Captive Ball
shots.notes: Each hit throbs the red flashers with a matching bass hit; three hits starts the RED mode.

shots.name: Centre Ramp
shots.notes: Loops around behind Arnie's head, across the playfield, and into the left inlane.

shots.name: Right Ramp
shots.notes: A sharp turnaround that feeds the right inlane.

shots.name: Right Loop
shots.notes: Collects escape awards and feeds the upper sink holes. Lights for the RPG challenge once R-P-G is spelled.

shots.name: R-P-G Standups
shots.notes: Three standups on the right, each lighting one letter. Completing the word lights the right loop to start the RPG challenge.

shots.name: RPG Backbox Targets
shots.notes: Five standup targets in an arc inside the backbox, fired at with a launcher that swings back and forth through about 60 degrees. Trigger a shot with the shooter button or a flipper button.

shots.name: Upper Sink Holes
shots.notes: A cluster at the top of the game, most often fed by a left-loop shot that doesn't complete, and also reachable off the right loop.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: The only adjustable outlane on the machine, and still wide open on default settings — there's virtually no ball saver here.

goals.title: Pick a Launch Award
goals.summary: No skill shot here — instead you choose from a menu of launch awards before the ball even reaches the flippers, and the menu grows as the game goes on.
instructions: Choose one of the launch awards offered at the start of each ball
Early choices are Bonus X, Mystery, and TX Challenge
Later in the game the menu adds Start RPG, Lock Ball, and others
TX Challenge is generally the strongest of the early picks — it feeds a fast, repeatable points run

goals.title: TX Challenge
goals.summary: Picking TX Challenge feeds the ball to the TX sink hole for a 'Shoot anything' countdown — any loop, ramp, or the lock lane counts, and routing through the lock lane restarts the whole thing as Bonus Challenge.
goals.reward: Up to 2.5M per round, twice over if you route through the lock lane

steps.action: The ball feeds into the TX sink hole to start the countdown
steps.detail: Value starts at 2.5M and ticks down in 0.5M chunks over about five seconds as Arnie counts from five to one

steps.action: Shoot any loop, ramp, or the lock lane before the count runs out
steps.detail: Anything qualifies except the captive ball — but if multiball is already primed and waiting on a final lock shot, shots made here as part of the Challenge won't count toward it

steps.action: Route the shot through the lock lane specifically for a bonus restart
steps.detail: The drop target lowers so the ball falls straight into the sink hole — you bank the current value and start Bonus Challenge, the same countdown again with the drop target raised this time

goals.title: Relight the Kickback
goals.summary: The left outlane's kickback goes dark after a save and only comes back once all three red standups above it are down.
goals.reward: A relit kickback save on the left outlane

steps.action: Knock down all three standups above the left outlane
steps.detail: Relights the kickback for another save

goals.title: RED
goals.summary: Three hits on the captive ball starts RED — all three ramps and both loops light at once, and you're on the clock to collect all five before time runs out.
goals.reward: All five shots relight plus a weapon upgrade; stackable with multiball, and startable even while multiball is already running

steps.action: Hit the captive ball three times to start the mode
steps.detail: Each hit throbs the red flashers with a matching bass hit — one of the game's better sound moments

steps.action: Shoot any of the five lit shots
steps.detail: All three ramps and both loops count, in any order

steps.action: Clear the rest of the five before the timer ends
steps.detail: Extra captive-ball hits and the kickback standups both extend the clock

goals.title: Payback Time
goals.summary: Alternate the left and right ramps to build a security level on each side — five clean hits apiece opens Payback Time, a timed run where the ramps pay a flat million every shot.
goals.reward: 1M per ramp shot during the timed round

steps.action: Build the left security level with five ramp hits
Build the right security level with five ramp hits
steps.detail: Working both sides quickly rather than one at a time is worth it

steps.action: With both sides at five, Payback Time starts
steps.detail: Ramps pay a flat 1M each while the clock runs

goals.title: TX Multiball
goals.summary: A real, physical lock — three balls into the TX Lock Lane launches multiball outright, then it's the same lane over and over for jackpots, and Super Jackpots once the drop target stays down.
goals.reward: Repeating jackpots, then Super Jackpots at the same lock lane

steps.action: Lock three balls at the TX Lock Lane
steps.detail: Real locks — a fresh ball launches after each one, with no separate launch award along the way

steps.action: Keep hammering the lock lane for jackpots
steps.detail: The same shot pays again and again once multiball is running

steps.action: Once the drop target stays down, the same shot pays Super Jackpots
steps.detail: Watch for the TX's arm and head flashers strobing when you land one

goals.title: Spell R-P-G
goals.summary: Three standups on the right spell R-P-G one letter at a time — complete the word and the right loop lights to send you to the backbox challenge.
goals.reward: Lights the RPG challenge at the right loop

steps.action: Light one letter per standup hit
steps.detail: Completing the word lights the right loop

goals.title: RPG Backbox Challenge
goals.summary: The rocket-propelled-grenade minigame: a launcher swings through about 60 degrees while you fire at five arced standups against a countdown that starts at five million.
goals.reward: Countdown bonus, plus extra for using fewer than five shots and for hitting the targets in order

steps.action: Time the swinging launcher and fire at the five arced targets
steps.detail: Trigger a shot with the shooter button or a flipper button; the countdown runs from 5M down to 1M, then gives three more seconds of grace

steps.action: Clear all five before the grace period ends
steps.detail: The uppermost target is the hardest to line up

goals.title: Video Mode: Tank Assault
goals.summary: A tank-shooting video mode borrowed almost note for note from T2, with the robots swapped out for armor.
instructions: Steer the crosshairs left and right with the flippers
Shoot the tanks before they get a shot off at you
Taking three hits ends the mode
Clear every tank to win, and avoid all incoming fire for a flawless bonus
goals.reward: Points per tank destroyed, plus a flawless bonus for a clean run

goals.title: Strategy: Safe Opening
goals.summary: This is a drain-prone machine on default settings — get the kickback armed early, treat the lock lane as a real shot rather than a rebound, and take TX Challenge at the launch menu for a reliable start.

steps.action: Pick TX Challenge from the launch menu
steps.detail: The most reliable of the early choices, and it can restart itself for a second run through the lock lane

steps.action: Clear the three kickback standups early
steps.detail: Both outlanes run wide open by default, so get the save armed as soon as you can

steps.action: Aim the lock lane with intent, not by accident
steps.detail: A weak exit here is one of the game's biggest drain sources

goals.title: Strategy: Stack Everything
goals.summary: RED stacks cleanly on top of multiball, Payback Time builds in the background whenever the ramps are open, and the RPG challenge is worth saving for a calmer single-ball moment.

steps.action: Start RED even with multiball already running
steps.detail: The two stack cleanly, and RED's timer keeps you focused on five specific shots instead of just hammering the lock

steps.action: Work Payback Time's security levels between multiball attempts
steps.detail: Alternate ramps whenever the lock lane isn't the priority shot

steps.action: Save the RPG challenge for a calm single-ball moment
steps.detail: It's a precision shot on a swinging launcher, not something to chase mid-multiball

achievements.title: Countdown Cashed
achievements.desc: Collect the TX Challenge value before the countdown runs out.

achievements.title: Reloaded
achievements.desc: Clear all three kickback standups to relight the left outlane save.

achievements.title: R-P-G Spelled
achievements.desc: Complete the R-P-G standups to light the backbox challenge.

achievements.title: Red Alert
achievements.desc: Hit the captive ball three times to start RED.

achievements.title: Security Clearance
achievements.desc: Build both security levels to five and light Payback Time.

achievements.title: Three Locked
achievements.desc: Lock three balls at the TX Lock Lane to start multiball.

achievements.title: Five For Five
achievements.desc: Clear all five RPG backbox targets before the grace period ends.

achievements.title: Flawless Victory
achievements.desc: Clear Tank Assault video mode without taking a single hit.

achievements.title: Everything At Once
achievements.desc: Start RED mode while multiball is already running.
